# Portfolio Value Creation

⚠️ **Finance warning / Avertissement finance** : informational only, not investment advice. A value creation plan maps intent, it does not deliver it: levers slip, acquisitions disappoint, there is a real risk of loss in any portfolio company, and no bridge here is a promise of return. Curated by Skill Harbor: the portfolio value creation skill of the private equity pack in andreworia/claude-finance-skills. Use it in the four to six weeks before close, when the deal team builds the 100-day plan and value creation roadmap for the first board meeting, and quarterly afterwards to review performance against plan and refresh the workstreams; it applies to buy-and-build platforms and to organic growth businesses. The method produces four linked deliverables. First, a 100-day plan that is a sequenced priority plan rather than a to-do list, structured as stabilise (retention, top-ten customer communication, supplier and bank handover, IT audit, done in the first 30 days), understand (operating picture, management assessment by direct observation, pipeline and open legal or HR matters, by day 60), build (reporting upgrade from a 30-day close toward a 10-day close, key gap hires, board cadence and reporting pack, substantially by day 90) and begin value creation (two to three high-impact, low-effort initiatives only), each action with owner, deadline, success criterion and dependency.
